title: Jackly JK 6032-A Multi-Functional 32 in 1 Small Hand Combination Screw Driver Tools Kit

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Jackly JK-6032-A Multi-Functional Batch of Head Screwdrivers is a compact and reliable small hand tools kit designed for precision repair work.

This combination screwdriver set includes a variety of high-quality interchangeable bits suitable for mobile phone repair, laptop servicing, electronics maintenance, watches, toys, and small household devices. Built with durable chrome-vanadium steel bits and an ergonomic non-slip handle, the Jackly JK-6032-A ensures stable performance and precise handling. Its lightweight storage case keeps all tools organized, making it a perfect choice for technicians, DIY users, and everyday home repairs in Bangladesh.


Key Features

  • Multi-Functional Tool Kit – Comes with multiple screwdriver bits for a wide range of electronic and household repair tasks.
  • High-Quality Steel Bits – Made from durable chrome-vanadium steel for long-lasting strength and precision.
  • Ergonomic Handle – Features a comfortable non-slip grip for better control and reduced hand fatigue.
  • Magnetic Driver Design – Helps hold tiny screws securely for easier, faster repair work.
  • Compact Storage Box – Neatly organizes all bits and the handle in a portable, lightweight case.
  • Wide Compatibility – Suitable for smartphone repair, laptop servicing, camera adjustments, toys, watches, and small appliances.
  • Ideal for Professionals & DIY Users – Perfect for technicians, hobbyists, and home users needing a dependable precision screwdriver set.
  • Easy to Carry – Small, travel-friendly design ensures convenience anywhere you go.
